mapper.select: SELECT si.*, sc.name AS category_name FROM supply_item si LEFT JOIN supply_category sc ON si.category_id = sc.id WHERE si.id = #{id}
SELECT si.*, sc.name AS category_name FROM supply_item si LEFT JOIN supply_category sc ON si.category_id = sc.id WHERE si.status = 1 AND si.quantity <= si.warning_quantity ORDER BY si.quantity ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supply_item (category_id, name, code, specification, unit, manufacturer, storage_condition, quantity, warning_quantity, is_hazardous, status, remark) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{code}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{manufacturer}, #{storageCondition}, IFNULL(#{quantity}, 0), IFNULL(#{warningQuantity}, 10), IFNULL(#{isHazardous}, 0), IFNULL(#{status}, 1), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE supply_item SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, specification = #{specification}, unit = #{unit}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, storage_condition = #{storageCondition}, warning_quantity = #{warningQuantity}, is_hazardous = #{isHazardous}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE supply_item SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
